newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo wins $90 mln offshore plant order.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo wins $90 mln offshore plant order.

text.p: Daewoo Heavy Industries Ltd, a shipbuilding and heavy machinery affiliate of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Tuesday it has won a $90 million order to build an offshore platform in Russia.

A Daewoo statement said the company has signed a contract with Marathon Oil Co of the United States. The U.S. company is the leader of a consortium, consisting of five foreign companies, to develop oil off Sakhalin.

Daewoo Heavy will deliver the platform in August 1998, after renovating oil exploration modules in the Beaufort Sea, Canada. The company plans to transfer exploration facilities from Canada to its shipyards in Korea.
